prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have enhanced in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply working methods from computer science to the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstraction skills, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competences preferably from the field of technical computer science

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercises, at least 50 percent of points
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercises

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire ECTS, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises and orally present the solution of at least two exercises. The examination performance consists of either a written exam or an individual oral examination.
